# Data

The raw and processed data files are not included in this repository.

The firm-level financial data come from Compustat and are proprietary. The code is provided to document the full analytical workflow and can be run by users with authorized access to the required datasets.

## Expected input files

### Raw data

- `data/raw/compustat_1999.csv`
- `data/raw/POILWTIUSDM.csv`
- `data/raw/ASM_2008_31GS101_with_ann.csv`
- `data/raw/BH2_supply_shocks.xlsx`
- `data/raw/BH2_demand_shocks.xlsx`

### Processed data generated by `01_data_preparation.py`

- `data/processed/thesis_model_df.csv`
- `data/processed/panel_patch_controls.csv`

## Reproducibility note

The scripts use relative paths and documented variable definitions so the workflow can be reproduced by users with authorized access to the required raw data.
